text: What is tax evasion? Benny about to find out.
Benny fix cars for cash. Whole year, fifty thousand dollars.
Benny happy. Finally buy new truck.
Tax time. Government say: fill out this form.
You earn fifty thousand? Government take like ten thousand. For roads. For schools.
Benny have idea. Cash leave no paper. Just lie on form.
Now tax only like seven hundred. Benny keep almost ten thousand extra.
Benny buy new truck. New house. New jet ski.
But truck dealer report big cash to IRS. Over ten thousand? IRS know.
IRS. Internal Revenue Service. They compare. Bank. Truck. House. It no match.
IRS agent come. Benny hide at home. Agent already there. Benny run to woods. Agent there too.
IRS catch Benny. Pay back the tax. Plus seventy-five percent fraud penalty. Plus interest.
And tax evasion is a felony. Up to five years in jail.
Two things certain in life: death and taxes. Next video: how rich people pay less, legally.
